fact: The US Country Commercial Guide says MTNIMA, the Mauritanian digital ministry, has published the National AI Strategy (2025-2029); the guide gives no date for the publication, so the document's published date of 2026-02-10 is used.
Ecofin Agency states Mauritania has a national artificial intelligence strategy for 2025-2029 providing for applications in healthcare, education, agriculture and transportation.

The minister of digital transformation opened a workshop presenting Mauritania's national AI strategy (2025-2029; 6 priorities, 16 objectives, 38 actions), prepared with GIZ support, and said it will be implemented soon; no adoption is stated.

The two-day Nouakchott international AI conference, opened by the higher-education ministry on 26 May 2025, was to present the national AI strategy and hold a round table on it; no adoption is stated.
The digital transformation ministry held a one-day consultation workshop in Nouakchott on the content of Mauritania's national AI strategy, opened by Minister Mohamed Abdellahi Louli.
